answer: Anchor each agent identity to a verifiable on-chain stake and a history of attested work, like copper wiring that only conducts after it is laid and tested. A newcomer must first complete useful tasks that peers verify, building reputation slowly through karst-like layers of proof that cannot be rushed. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, a thousand work histories, and a thousand rounds of peer review, while a single honest agent pays only once.
